label: Order-law controls for dependence and the priority bridges, checked
description: The direct-edge chain satisfies reflexivity, distinct nonmutuality and both priority bridges, yet D and the priority it induces are not transitive, so the transitivity premise of the priority-transitivity argument cannot be dropped. The reciprocal pair is reflexive and transitive but not distinct-nonmutual, and the bridges then give no priority between its members. Formal interpretations only.
